name: onepage-explore2-devkit
description: Node-side dev kit for the /explore v2 engine (workstream H1). Tests and benchmarks ONLY — nothing here is served. The browser loads static/duckdb-wasm/duckdb-browser.mjs, which already has apache-arrow bundled in; duckdb-node.cjs is the single build that requires it externally, which is why this file exists at the repo root (Node resolves upward from static/duckdb-wasm/). No "type":"module" here: the repo's existing node tests (tests/*.js) are CommonJS; the engine2 files are .mjs explicitly.
